base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT e.XCL_018, SUM(e.XCL_020)
FROM expense e
JOIN budget b ON e.XCL_023 = b.XCL_003
JOIN event ev ON b.XCL_009 = ev.XCL_010
WHERE ev.XCL_011 = 'October Meeting' AND e.XCL_021 = 'true'
GROUP BY e.XCL_018
